proof_audit: CRR probability uses ex-dividend drift r-q. Reinvesting a proportional dividend from Delta exp(-q dt) initial shares yields Delta next-date shares, producing the stated two-state pricing weight. Strict interior probability domain is enforced rather than clipped.

Finite Snell recursion proved by backward domination and constructive attainment with an adapted first-exercise rule. Nested dates increase value only when transitions and information are held fixed. Cross-N CRR refinement changes the law; neither monotone convergence nor an American limit rate is claimed.

Log-price/discount transformation gives w_tau=a w_xx+b w_x with a=sigma^2/2, b=r-q-a. Explicit weights have correct drift orientation, are nonnegative under separate spatial and CFL conditions, and sum to one. Maximum principle includes every initial and boundary node.

Taylor/integral remainder constants k Mtt/2, a h^2 M4/12 and |b| h^2 M3/6 are derived. Convexity propagates one-step residuals to epsilon+T eta. Continuity and bounded derivatives on the closed rectangle are explicit; the vanilla kink does not meet those hypotheses.

Manufactured exponential derivative suprema and maximum-norm bound are analytical, verified by an independent forward stopped-walk representation. Exact vanilla boundaries isolate mesh error; the alternate boundary envelope bounds the difference between the two discrete schemes only. Negative-rate discount conversion is retained.
Implicit positive-operator extension uses a strict discrete-minimum argument; no unproved Crank-Nicolson positivity claim. The laboratory implements only the explicit scheme.

IID estimator mean/variance, unbiased sample variance and fixed-n CLT scope are distinguished from deterministic PRNG diagnostics. Bounded-payoff Hoeffding bound proved via tilted variance, log-MGF integration and Markov optimization; no same bound applied to generally unbounded stock controls.

Antithetic variance identities now explicitly require square integrability. Independent-copy covariance identity proves nonpositive covariance for opposite monotonicity, with equality allowed. Independent units are pair means; f(z)=z^2 proves the method can worsen variance for a nonmonotone payoff.

Fixed control sign and completed-square minimum derived. Independent pilot conditioning preserves unbiasedness under integrability; same-sample fitting does not inherit this proof. Truncated lognormal moments derive the raw optimal coefficient; paired moments differ, illustrated by an actual increase when methods are combined.

Frozen adapted policy independently evaluated has conditional expected value no greater than the finite-grid optimal stopping supremum. Explicit samples may exceed that optimum. No regression consistency, full duality, continuously monitored barrier convergence or universal LSM guarantee claimed.

SHA256 counter byte protocol, 53-bit midpoint rounding cap and Box-Muller ideal polar proof stated separately. The finite deterministic stream is not asserted to be independent normal draws. Analytical moments and interval formulas concern the ideal reference law.

limitations: Author verification is not external academic certification or empirical market validation.

General tree/optimal-stopping convergence, nonsmooth PDE rates, regression consistency, continuous-barrier corrections, multilevel/QMC and general SDE weak convergence are further study, not proved here.
The exact-boundary vanilla PDE is a verification device; finite asymptotic boundaries and raw payoff initialization have distinct errors.
The generator is deterministic; mathematical IID/CLT/Hoeffding results concern an ideal reference law. Seed reproduction is not a proof of random-stream quality or coverage.
Control variance reduction is not guaranteed for arbitrary coefficients or composition with pairing. Feasible-policy lower bounds are expectations rather than samplewise inequalities.
